data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to create alarms, timers and open the Android clock app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a thin wrapper around Android clock intents. You can create alarms, create timers, and open the system clock UI for alarms or timers.
use_when: You need to schedule alarms or timers using the native Android clock UI
You want a simple way to launch the clock app from Flutter
avoid_when: Your app must run on iOS or other platforms
You need advanced alarm management or callbacks
strengths: Works with the default system clock
weaknesses: Limited to opening the system UI, no result callbacks
